fieldValues.title: RFC for the spec exposition metastructure
fieldValues.summary: The RFC that states the concept-tree metastructure as a normative proposal: tree by contains, order by precedes, prerequisites by depends-on, with no new relation types and no new fields. Drafted as RFC-042 Rev 1 and put to the owner; acceptance is a separate owner act.
fieldValues.body: PR https://github.com/the-greenman/srs/pull/620 — RFC-042 Draft Rev 1, open for owner merge (Door 2: new normative meaning, so the thread may not merge it whatever the mode). Executes the owner's 2026-09-05 ruling on #556: the spine needs no new primitives, so the RFC's eight changes (A tree and edges, B leaf Types with mechanism replacing subsection, C example records replacing fenced prose, D Parts as root-container nav sections, E invariants as leaves with applies_to retired, F five coherence checks, G navigation and rendering, H the zero-context-agent acceptance test) all sit inside the existing contains/precedes/depends-on vocabulary. Consumes #608 (the concept graph is not a DAG; the SCC is the unit of layering) and #609. Zero new fields, zero new relation types, no schema change, dataModelRevision unchanged. Five open questions are carried in the RFC with recommendations rather than resolved by the thread. Proof: validate-all exit 0, check-spec-language exit 0 with the registry's 40 patterns run over the RFC text at 0 hits.
